title: InteractionFeatures
description: Features for one candidate pair at one frame. A classifier window is a time-ordered list of these for the same pair. Contains NO allergen fields (invariant 6); additionalProperties is false so none can be added without an RFC.

distance.description: Box-center distance in normalized frame widths.

inside_zone.description: a is inside the zone that b occupies (e.g. a tool inside a bin slot).

zone_kind.description: Zone type only; never the zone ID, so the classifier cannot learn which bin is which.

speed_a.description: Box-center speed in normalized frame widths per second.

speed_b.description: Box-center speed in normalized frame widths per second.

dwell_ms.description: How long the pair has been within candidate range.

wrist_proximity.description: Distance from the nearest wrist to the pair; null if no wrist nearby.
